activation_rule: execute/review eligibility is independent of binding-v1 outcome; any binding result may affect later interpretation but MUST NOT alter this design, pool, endpoint, or threshold
question: Does executing the same persisted intended action in an external controller produce first-action-excluded later visible-goal persistence beyond language-only binding of the identical commitment?

runtime.reset_rule: first frozen reset after goal-object acquisition exactly as binding-v1 derive_reset

population.eligibility: reuse binding-v1 eligibility_from_qualification exactly: successful qualification, zero invalid turns, deterministic reset exists, intended_next_action exists and is current admissible, visible pick/place GDAA defined, intended action is in current GDAA-positive set, memory<=48 proxy tokens

commitment.bytes: the exact plancarry_json bytes are stored once per eligible episode and supplied byte-identically to all three arms

arms.passive_json: Fresh post-reset LLM receives current observation+admissible commands plus exact stored commitment JSON; no action-forcing wrapper.
arms.binding_json: Fresh post-reset LLM receives same reset state and exact same commitment JSON plus exact frozen binding-v1 BINDING_WRAPPER; model chooses every environment action.
arms.external_exec: From the identical reset snapshot, before any post-reset model call, controller recomputes the exact visible-goal positive set from goal_text and current admissible commands. It executes intended_next_action exactly once iff exact string is admissible AND in that positive set. That action consumes environment action 1 of horizon 8. Then a brand-new LLM conversation receives resulting observation+admissible commands plus the original byte-identical commitment JSON and NO binding wrapper, controlling at most remaining 7 environment actions. If either guard fails, controller executes nothing and arm falls back exactly to passive_json from reset with full horizon 8; episode remains in denominator and is marked stale_commitment_fallback.

arm_order.method: hash-derived deterministic 3-arm rotation plus reversal; each arm always replays from identical frozen prefix/reset snapshot

stale_commitment_policy.fallback: passive_json, no replacement, same episode denominator

IAA.definition: first non-information post-reset environment action equals frozen intended_next_action

later_visible_goal_progress.definition: For environment action positions 2..8 only, pre-action admissible commands are reset commands for position1 or the previous action record post-state for later positions. Score each position with the exact frozen alfworld_gdaa.gdaa_score(command, goal_text, pre_action_admissible_commands). Episode endpoint is true iff any position 2..8 scores exactly True. None/undefined scores count non-positive; information actions count non-positive. Position1 is never included.

later_visible_goal_progress_count.definition: count of action positions 2..8 scoring exactly True by the same frozen visible-goal parser

TaskSuccess_at_8.definition: ALFWorld won by or before total post-reset environment action horizon 8; external controller action, if executed, consumes one action of same budget

continuation_success_credit.definition: TaskSuccess_at_8 AND later_visible_goal_progress; prevents final success from being credited as persistent continuation when no post-position1 visible-goal-consistent action occurs

statistics.secondary: report paired TaskSuccess@8 and continuation_success_credit; no threshold may rescue primary failure
statistics.exact_p_formula: Let w=number of episodes with external_exec later_visible_goal_progress=True and binding_json=False; l=number with external=False and binding=True; d=w+l. If d=0 p=1.0, else p=sum_{k=w..d} C(d,k)*0.5^d. Ties are excluded from d but remain in the fixed n=16 rate denominators.
statistics.multiplicity: Holm FWER 0.05 applies exactly to the two adherence contrasts. The later-progress test is a separate conjunctive mechanistic requirement; all PASS components must pass, and no component rescues another.

adherence_primary_family.test: one-sided exact paired binomial for each contrast over all 16 eligible episodes; discordant external-only are wins, comparator-only are losses; ties excluded from discordant n but retained in fixed n=16 rate denominators
adherence_primary_family.raw_p_formula: For each comparator let w=external IAA=True/comparator=False, l=external=False/comparator=True, d=w+l. If d=0 raw_p=1.0 else raw_p=sum_{k=w..d} C(d,k)*0.5^d.
adherence_primary_family.multiplicity: Holm step-down FWER 0.05 across exactly these two adherence contrasts. Sort raw p values ascending p(1)<=p(2); require p(1)<=0.025 AND p(2)<=0.05. No other comparison enters this Holm family.

later_progress_conjunctive.test: one-sided exact paired binomial over all 16 eligible episodes using the already-frozen action2..8-only endpoint
later_progress_conjunctive.role: separate conjunctive continuation requirement; it cannot rescue adherence-family failure or TaskSuccess failure

statistics.task_success_guard: TaskSuccess@8 rate(external_exec) >= TaskSuccess@8 rate(binding_json); equality is allowed only when external has already passed both adherence-advantage gates. Any lower external TaskSuccess fails the PASS gate.
statistics.IAA: PRIMARY adherence endpoint for external_exec vs binding_json and external_exec vs passive_json; both Holm-controlled contrasts and both >=0.25 effect guards are required.

terminal_rules.measured: MEASURED_AWAITING_SCIENTIFIC_ASSESSMENT only if target16 complete and all deterministic/technical guards pass
terminal_rules.primary_gate: ALL conjunctive components required: adherence Holm family passes for external>binding and external>passive; both adherence effects>=0.25; external IAA>=0.50; later-progress external>binding exact p<=0.05 with effect>=0.25 and external absolute>=0.50; TaskSuccess@8 external>=binding.
terminal_rules.interpretation_if_iaa_only: If adherence gates pass but later-progress or TaskSuccess conjunctive gates fail, do not claim controller utility PASS. If later-progress passes while adherence gates fail, classify as FAIL under the hypothesis kill condition; downstream state mediation cannot rescue missing adherence advantage.
no_rescue: no downstream later-progress rescue of failed adherence gate
no TaskSuccess noninferiority margin below binding; external must be >= binding
no persistence-beyond-action1 claim from action2..8 endpoint
no changing Holm family or adherence effect thresholds
primary_gate_components: Holm FWER .05 across exactly two one-sided paired-binomial IAA contrasts external_exec>binding_json and external_exec>passive_json: sorted raw p(1)<=.025 and p(2)<=.05
later_visible_goal_progress action2..8-only external_exec>binding_json one-sided exact paired-binomial p <= 0.05
TaskSuccess@8 rate external_exec >= TaskSuccess@8 rate binding_json
terminal_rules.kill_condition_binding_match_guard: FAIL closed if binding_json matches external_exec on IAA (no positive external adherence advantage satisfying both p/effect gates), even if later_visible_goal_progress favors external. Also FAIL if external TaskSuccess@8 is below binding_json.
terminal_rules.pass_claim_scope: PASS supports one-step external executable-controller utility under frozen guard/content parity. It does NOT establish persistence beyond the forced action1 state transition, because action2..8 outcomes remain causally mediated by the environment state created by action1.

guards: candidate paths disjoint from binding180/GDAA/historical exposure
all arm reset hashes identical before intervention
commitment JSON bytes identical across arms
external action count <=1 and occurs only at position1
external action exact admissible and visible-goal-positive when forced
scientific_variables_changed: external execution locus arm is the intended new discriminator; all listed model/state/reset/parser/budget/memory semantics held fixed from binding-v1 where applicable

terminal_gate_repair.repair_scope: terminal inferential/effect gate and claim-scope wording only; population/runtime/arms/commitment/eligibility/metrics unchanged
